related.title: Google SRE事後檢討：案例組成偏差與改善效果驗證
related.titleEn: Google SRE postmortems: case-mix bias and verification of improvement effects
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付oncall-work.csv、response-vs-followup.json、excluded-work.md與automation-review.md；所有人名使用虛構角色代號。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver oncall-work.csv, response-vs-followup.json, excluded-work.md and automation-review.md. Use fictional role identifiers and preserve the distinction between observed demand, available capacity and work deliberately excluded from analysis.
related.difference: 保存每個情境的版本、難度分層及結果，分別計算總比例與固定權重標準化比例；對因果改善維持合理證據界線。
related.differenceEn: Preserve scenario version, difficulty stratum and outcome. Calculate pooled and fixed-weight standardized proportions separately, maintaining an appropriate boundary between descriptive improvement and causal evidence.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: SRE值班實務重視可持續工作量與工程改善；本課40小時分母及工作時間均為教學假設，並非所有組織的工時標準或人力建議。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 一個合成週可用工程時間40小時；10件事件各即時處理1小時、後續1.5小時，無重疊工時計入，其他工作暫排除。 完整事件工時10×(1+1.5)=25小時，占62.5%；只計即時處理會報10小時、25%，漏掉15小時。

SRE事後檢討要求可追蹤的改進；此課分層統計是原創驗證方法，不是Google規定的評分公式，也不能單靠前後對照排除所有混淆。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 改善前容易100件成功90、困難100件成功10；改善後容易900成功810、困難100成功10。層內成功率皆維持90%與10%。 前總成功100/200=50%，後820/1000=82%；以各50%固定權重標準化，前後皆(90%+10%)/2=50%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: SRE on-call practice emphasizes sustainable workload and engineering improvement. The forty-hour denominator and task durations are teaching assumptions, not a universal workweek standard or staffing recommendation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. A synthetic week provides forty engineering hours. Ten incidents each require one immediate-response hour and 1.5 follow-up hours, counted without overlapping person-hours; other work is excluded from this fixture. Total incident work is 10×(1+1.5)=25 hours, or 62.5%. Counting only response would report ten hours and 25%, omitting fifteen hours of required follow-up.

SRE postmortem practice supports accountable improvement. The stratified calculation is an original verification method, not a prescribed Google scoring formula; before/after comparison alone cannot eliminate all confounding. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Before the change, easy cases have ninety successes out of 100 and hard cases ten out of 100. Afterward, easy cases have 810 out of 900 and hard cases ten out of 100. Pooled success rises from 100/200=50% to 820/1000=82%. Standardizing both periods to equal stratum weights gives (90%+10%)/2=50% in each period.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: Microsoft Entra federation: exact issuer, subject and audience contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付oncall-work.csv、response-vs-followup.json、excluded-work.md與automation-review.md；所有人名使用虛構角色代號。

related.difference: 建立九筆包含issuer、subject、audience的合成claims；其中涵蓋大小寫、尾端斜線、不同tenant及不同audience。將token驗證成功與聯邦條件符合分開記錄。
related.differenceEn: Create nine synthetic claim tuples covering case changes, trailing slashes, another tenant and another audience. Record cryptographic token validity separately from matching the configured federation conditions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: SRE值班實務重視可持續工作量與工程改善；本課40小時分母及工作時間均為教學假設，並非所有組織的工時標準或人力建議。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 一個合成週可用工程時間40小時；10件事件各即時處理1小時、後續1.5小時，無重疊工時計入，其他工作暫排除。 完整事件工時10×(1+1.5)=25小時，占62.5%；只計即時處理會報10小時、25%，漏掉15小時。

已通過簽章檢查的token仍須符合預期issuer、subject和audience；對本課標準精確比對憑證採大小寫敏感的三欄AND，不以正規化掩蓋設定差異。 九筆中4筆三欄皆正確；修正兩筆設定的subject大小寫後，在相同token與簽章前提下有6筆符合。 符合比例4/9×100=44.4444444%；修正後6/9×100=66.6666667%。錯tenant與錯audience仍必須拒絕。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: SRE on-call practice emphasizes sustainable workload and engineering improvement. The forty-hour denominator and task durations are teaching assumptions, not a universal workweek standard or staffing recommendation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. A synthetic week provides forty engineering hours. Ten incidents each require one immediate-response hour and 1.5 follow-up hours, counted without overlapping person-hours; other work is excluded from this fixture. Total incident work is 10×(1+1.5)=25 hours, or 62.5%. Counting only response would report ten hours and 25%, omitting fifteen hours of required follow-up.

A signature-valid token must still match expected issuer, subject and audience. The standard exact-match credential in this exercise uses case-sensitive three-field AND conditions rather than normalization that hides configuration differences. Four of nine tuples match all three fields. Correcting subject case in two configuration entries yields six matches against the same tokens, with signature-validation outcomes unchanged. Matching share is 4/9×100=44.4444444%, increasing to 6/9×100=66.6666667%. Another tenant and an incorrect audience remain rejected regardless of that improved fixture statistic.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
